lines.en: label day297:
scene toukafirstday1
: So yeah! That’s basically how I wound up becoming the adoptive mother of an energy draining chicken named Todd!
lines.zh: : 就是这样！基本上，我就是这么成了 Todd 的养母的——那是一只专门吸走人精力的鸡！

lines.en: : Woah! I had no idea the story behind that little guy was so heart wrenching and inspiring, Ayane!
lines.zh: : 哇！我还不知道那小家伙背后的故事这么催人泪下又励志呢，Ayane！

lines.en: : When exactly did my podium become a place for bird related gossip?
lines.zh: : 我的讲台到底是从什么时候变成聊鸟八卦的地方了？

lines.en: scene toukafirstday2
: This here’s a free country, Sensei. Every podium is a bird gossip podium if you try hard and believe in yourself!
lines.zh: : 这可是个自由的国家，Sensei。只要你肯努力、肯相信自己，每个讲台都可以是聊鸟八卦的讲台！

lines.en: : Also, Nodoka stole my desk and has just been sitting there staring off into space for the last hour or so, so I have nothing else to do.
lines.zh: : 而且 Nodoka 霸占了我的桌子，这一个小时左右就一直坐在那儿发呆，所以我没别的事可干。

lines.en: : But it actually works out perfectly since I wanted to be around you anyway!
lines.zh: : 不过其实正好，因为我本来就一直想待在你身边嘛！

lines.en: : You always want to be around me. Don’t make it sound like some sort of special occurrence.
lines.zh: : 你什么时候都想待在我身边。别说得好像多稀奇似的。

lines.en: : Yes, yes! Flirt harder! Just what I need to get my blood pumpin’ first thing in the morning!
lines.zh: : 对对！调情再猛点！一大早正需要这个让我热血沸腾！

lines.en: : This doesn’t really constitute flirting, Uta.
lines.zh: : 这可算不上调情，Uta。

lines.en: : I figured if anyone would know that, it would be you.
lines.zh: : 我想如果有人懂这个，那应该是你吧。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday3
: Hey, now! Don’t go giving my good friend here any ideas about our totally platonic relationship, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哎哎！别给我这位好朋友灌输什么关于我们那绝对纯洁的关系的念头啊，Sensei。

lines.en: : I understand that you may be in love with me, but I am far too [young]to get involved with a man like you unless the price is right.
lines.zh: : 我明白你可能爱上我了，但我太[young]了，除非价格合适，否则不会跟像你这样的男人扯上关系。

lines.en: : What is the price? Just name it and I’ll make it happen.
lines.zh: : 价格是多少？你开个数，我就去办到。

lines.en: : Six million US dollars.
lines.zh: : 六百万美元。

lines.en: : Ayane, can I borrow six million US dollars?
lines.zh: : Ayane，能借我六百万美元吗？

lines.en: scene toukafirstday4
: How much money do you think my family made off of unpoppable bubble wrap, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我家靠捏不爆的气泡纸赚了多少钱啊，Sensei？

lines.en: : We may be rich, but even we can’t hand out that much just because it will help you purchase Uta.
lines.zh: : 我们家是有钱，但就算是为了帮你买下 Uta，也拿不出这么多。

lines.en: : So it’s not the fact that I want to purchase her, it’s the fact that she’s too expensive.
lines.zh: : 所以问题不在于我想买她，而在于她太贵了。

lines.en: : I’m a high quality product made with only the finest ingredients.
lines.zh: : 我可是用最上等的原料制成的高品质产品。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday5
: Also, you can have me for free. And I’ll do everything that Uta can plus more.
lines.zh: : 还有，我是免费的哦。Uta 能做的我都能做，还能做得更多。

lines.en: : That’s right, Sensei. And she doesn’t even need to talk to her parents first.
lines.zh: : 没错，Sensei。而且她连先跟爸妈商量都不用。

lines.en: : This baby right here can fit so much Sensei inside of her that you could probably even clone yourself and she still wouldn’t be satisfied.
lines.zh: : 这丫头里面能装下那么多 Sensei，就算你克隆一个自己出来，她也还是不会满足。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday6
: Oh, Uta. You say the strangest things sometimes. As if I’d ever need more than one Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哦，Uta。你有时候说话真奇怪。好像我还需要第二个 Sensei 似的。

lines.en: : That’s what she says...but just look at those eyes! She’s clearly in heat!
lines.zh: : 她是这么说啦……可你看看那双眼睛！明摆着是发情了！

lines.en: : In fact, she's so hot that just one Sensei wouldn’t even come close to-
lines.zh: : 事实上，她欲火旺盛到一个 Sensei 根本远远不够——

lines.en: : Please don’t continue saying things like this in a classroom full of girls who would likely kill both you and me for carrying on any longer.
lines.zh: : 拜托别再继续说这种话了，这一屋子女孩大概会因为你再讲下去，把你我都宰了。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday7
: Back to the matter at hand, then!
lines.zh: : 那就回到正事上来吧！

lines.en: : What matter at hand? You two spent ten minutes talking about a chicken. What more could there possibly be to say?
lines.zh: : 什么正事？你俩聊了十分钟鸡。还能有什么要说的？

lines.en: : No, no! Not chicken stuff!
lines.zh: : 不不不！不是鸡的事！

lines.en: : Ayane and me didn’t just stumble on over here because Nodoka went into hibernation mode. We came over because we had an idea to run by you!
lines.zh: : 我和 Ayane 过来，才不只是因为 Nodoka 进入冬眠模式了呢。我们来是因为有个点子想跟你商量！

lines.en: : An idea? What kind of idea?
lines.zh: : 点子？什么点子？

lines.en: scene toukafirstday8
: So, you know how the beach trip thing is right around the corner even though it’s the middle of winter?
lines.zh: : 那个，你知道吧，虽然现在是大冬天，海滩之行马上就要到了？

lines.en: : Yes. This has been a recurring subject lately.
lines.zh: : 知道。这最近是个反复出现的话题。

lines.en: : Do you two need me to watch you try on swimsuits as well?
lines.zh: : 你们俩也需要我看你们试泳衣吗？

lines.en: : Because that isn't really something I am interested in, but I will do it if you require financial advice and budgeting tips.
lines.zh: : 因为其实我对这事没什么兴趣，不过如果你们需要理财建议和省钱窍门的话，我还是照做。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday9
: As well? Who did ya watch the first time?
lines.zh: : 也？你第一次是看谁？

lines.en: : Wait, don’t tell me! It’s gotta be-
lines.zh: : 等等，别说！肯定是——

lines.en: : No one.
lines.zh: : 没谁。

lines.en: : Am I right, though?
lines.zh: : 不过我说得对吧？

lines.en: : Not really. I mean, I’d be more than happy to try on anything you want me to try on in front of you, but that’s not why we’re here.
lines.zh: : 不太对。我的意思是，你让我在你面前试什么我都非常乐意，但这不是我们来这儿的原因。

lines.en: : I don’t know my parents' rules for gettin’ changed in front of boys, but I’m pretty sure I’m not allowed to do that.
lines.zh: : 我不知道我爸妈对在男生面前换衣服有什么规矩，不过我挺确定他们是不准我这么干的。

lines.en: : Then what? What would be so important that you would interrupt my incredibly busy schedule to-
lines.zh: : 那是什么？到底有什么事重要到要来打断我忙得不可开交的日程——

lines.en: scene toukafirstday10
: An orgy.
lines.zh: : 一场群交。

lines.en: : Done. Let’s go.
lines.zh: : 成交。走吧。

lines.en: : An orgy of fun.
lines.zh: : 一场欢乐的群交。

lines.en: : I don’t know what that means, but as long as it’s still an orgy, I’m game.
lines.zh: : 我不知道那是什么意思，不过只要还是群交，我就奉陪。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday11
: Okay, now that we have your attention, we should clarify that it isn’t really an orgy at all.
lines.zh: : 好了，既然引起你的注意了，我们得澄清一下，那其实根本不是什么群交。

lines.en: : You already had my attention. Making false promises is just going to ruin my day.
lines.zh: : 你们本来就有我的注意。开空头支票只会毁了我这一天。

lines.en: : Why would you do this to me?
lines.zh: : 你们为什么要这样对我？

lines.en: : Because yeah!
lines.zh: : 因为——对啊！

lines.en: : What does that even mean?...
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么意思啊？……

lines.en: scene toukafirstday12
: All you really need to know is that Ayane and me are plannin’ a thing that we’re gonna need your help for soon!
lines.zh: : 你只要知道一件事就够了：我和 Ayane 正在筹划一件事，很快就需要你帮忙！

lines.en: : Why not right now? I have some time to kill.
lines.zh: : 为什么不是现在？我正好有时间要打发。

lines.en: : It wouldn’t be balanced enough! We need to even the playing field!
lines.zh: : 那样就不够平衡了！我们得先把场地拉平！

lines.en: : Thankfully, my cute girl senses are tingling and we’re about to get one step closer!
lines.zh: : 还好，我的可爱女孩直觉正在发麻，我们马上就要更近一步了！

lines.en: : Why do you have cute girl senses and what can I do to also get them?
lines.zh: : 为什么你会有可爱女孩直觉，我要怎么做才能也有？

lines.en: : Just close your eyes and believe, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 只要闭上眼睛去相信就好啦，Sensei……

lines.en: scene black
I close my eyes and attempt to believe.
lines.zh: 我闭上眼睛，努力去相信。

lines.en: The only issue is that I have no idea what I’m believing in and-
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是，我根本不知道自己在相信什么，而且——

lines.en: : Excuse us...
lines.zh: : 打扰一下……

lines.en: You have maybe(?) acquired Uta-chan’s second secret ability, cute girl sense!
lines.zh: 你或许(？)习得了 Uta 酱的第二种隐藏能力：可爱女孩直觉！

lines.en: scene toukafirstday13
: Hello again. And thanks for allowing my daughter to join your classroom.
lines.zh: : 又见面了。还有，谢谢你让我的女儿加入你的班级。

lines.en: : Yes...Thank you very much for accepting me on such short notice.
lines.zh: : 是的……非常感谢您在这么仓促的情况下收下我。

lines.en: : I do understand that my appearance may come at a rather inconvenient time, but I’m excited to get to know every-
lines.zh: : 我明白我的出现可能时机相当不巧，但我很期待能认识每一——

lines.en: scene toukafirstday14
: Wait...You wouldn’t happen to be the commoner I ran into at the dojo months prior, would you?
lines.zh: : 等等……你该不会就是几个月前我在道场撞见的那个平民吧？

lines.en: : Touka, darling. This man is your teacher now. You can not be calling him a commoner.
lines.zh: : Touka，亲爱的。这位先生现在是你的老师了。你不能叫他平民。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday15
: Ah! I sincerely apologize if I offended you.
lines.zh: : 啊！如果冒犯了您，我诚挚地道歉。

lines.en: : It’s just that the people I typically associate with are a lot...different from the ones here.
lines.zh: : 只是我平时来往的人，跟这里的人……差别很大。

lines.en: : Well, putting your ingrained judgementalness aside for a moment, I’d like to say hello and welcome to my totally normal classroom.
lines.zh: : 好吧，先暂时把你那根深蒂固的评判癖放一边——欢迎来到我这个完全正常的教室。

lines.en: : I hope you enjoy never learning anything ever again for the rest of your [high_school] life.
lines.zh: : 祝你享受在[high_school]剩下的日子里再也学不到任何东西的乐趣。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday16
: I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: : 您说什么？

lines.en: : Hahahah! See? Isn’t he hilarious?
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈！看吧？他是不是很逗？

lines.en: : It’s the perfect environment for you, dear.
lines.zh: : 这对你来说是最完美的环境了，亲爱的。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday17
: But, just to be sure, how about I stay here and observe you for the rest of the period? Just to make sure everything is up to our...expectations, of course.
lines.zh: : 不过为了保险起见，要不我留下来旁听剩下的课？当然，只是为了确保一切都符合我们的……期望。

lines.en: : That won’t be necess-
lines.zh: : 那就不必——

lines.en: : That sounds splendid. Thank you kindly, mother.
lines.zh: : 听起来棒极了。谢谢您，母亲。

lines.en: : Okay. I guess Tsubasa will be here today too.
lines.zh: : 好吧。看来 Tsubasa 今天也要待在这儿了。

lines.en: I can already tell that this is not going to go well.
lines.zh: 我已经能感觉到，这事不会顺利。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday18
: Holy crap. What’s the princess of Kumon-mi doing in our classroom?
lines.zh: : 我靠。Kumon-mi 的公主在我们教室干嘛？

lines.en: : Princess of Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 的公主？

lines.en: scene toukafirstday19
: She’s like...totally loaded.
lines.zh: : 她呀……超级有钱。

lines.en: : Like, loaded enough to have a classroom in our last[school] with her very own teachers and her very own lunch period and just...
lines.zh: : 有钱到在我们上一所[school]里独占一间教室、配专属老师、专属午餐时间，还有……

lines.en: : I don’t know. She’s got a lot of money.
lines.zh: : 我也说不上来。反正她钱很多。

lines.en: : I like her hat.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢她的帽子。

lines.en: : It’s...a good hat?
lines.zh: : 那是……一顶好帽子？

lines.en: : I want to wear her hat.
lines.zh: : 我想戴她的帽子。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday20
: Uhh...cool.
lines.zh: : 呃……挺好的。

lines.en: : What is...um...a princess...doing in our class?
lines.zh: : 那个……公主……来我们班干嘛？

lines.en: : That’s what I want to know.
lines.zh: : 这也正是我想知道的。

lines.en: : I could have sworn that I wouldn’t be seeing her again until our last[school] was...unearthed or rebuilt or whatever it is that family is doing to put it back together.
lines.zh: : 我本来还发誓说，在上一个[school]被……挖出来或者重建好之前，我是不会再见到她的——他们家到底在搞什么重建，随便叫什么吧。

lines.en: : Her family is funding the new Kumon-mi Academy?
lines.zh: : 新的 Kumon-mi 学园是她家出资的？

lines.en: : That’s what I heard at least. But they own like 10%% of the entire district, so it would make sense.
lines.zh: : 至少我是这么听说的。不过他们家握有整个区大概 10%% 的产权，所以也说得通。

lines.en: : What does her family even do?
lines.zh: : 她家到底是干什么的啊？

lines.en: : Beats me. Rich people stuff? Yakuza, maybe?
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。有钱人的勾当？也许是黑道？

lines.en: : She doesn’t look like the yakuza type...
lines.zh: : 她看起来不像黑道那类人……

lines.en: : Yeah. We already have a girl with connections like that and she’s basically the opposite of rich anyway.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我们已经有一个有那种背景的女生了，而且她基本上跟有钱完全相反。

lines.en: : Well...whatever the case...I doubt she’ll last.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不管怎样……我怀疑她待不久。

lines.en: : I give it like a week before she’s gone again. Calling it now.
lines.zh: : 我赌她一周之内就会再次消失。现在就这么说定了。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday21
: I’d like to thank you for allowing my mother to stay here and supervise.
lines.zh: : 我想感谢您允许我母亲留在这里监督。

lines.en: : I can assure you it will be just for today.
lines.zh: : 我向您保证，就只有今天而已。

lines.en: : It’s my very first time in a classroom with other girls my age, so I’m a little nervous.
lines.zh: : 这是我第一次和同龄的女孩们待在同一间教室里，所以我有点紧张。

lines.en: : Just don’t call anyone a commoner or a peasant and I’m sure you’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 只要别管谁叫平民或者贱民，我保证你不会有事。

lines.en: : Understood!
lines.zh: : 明白了！

lines.en: : Now, where is my desk? I’d like to begin today’s lessons with English, if you wouldn’t mind.
lines.zh: : 那么，我的桌子在哪儿？如果您不介意的话，我想以英语开始今天的课程。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s not how things really work here.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这儿的事情不是这么运作的。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday22
: It’s not?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？

lines.en: : It’s not.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : Kendo Princess, the time has come to choose a name for our newest recruit!
lines.zh: : 剑道公主，是时候为我们最新的新兵选个名字了！

lines.en: : I am thinking something seductive...like...maybe some sort of succubus name?
lines.zh: : 我在想一个诱人的……比如……某种魅魔的名字？

lines.en: : Are you familiar with succubi?
lines.zh: : 你熟悉魅魔吗？

lines.en: : Suck ...what?
lines.zh: : 吸……什么？

lines.en: : Please do not try to get me to do anything strange in the middle of class, Emerald Guardian.
lines.zh: : 请不要在上课时间怂恿我做奇怪的事情，翡翠守护者。

lines.en: : Do your students always spend their free time discussing...whatever those two are discussing?
lines.zh: : 您的学生们的空闲时间总是在讨论……那两位在讨论的那些东西吗？

lines.en: : They do. And you’ll be doing the same starting now.
lines.zh: : 是的。而且从现在起你也一样。

lines.en: : But...how will this impact my education?
lines.zh: : 可是……这不会影响我的教育吗？

lines.en: : If I don’t receive enough attention, I’ll fall behind in my studies and-
lines.zh: : 如果我得不到足够的关注，我的学业就会落后，而且——

lines.en: : You’ll be fine. Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 你会没事的。别担心。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday23
: What do you mean, “Don’t worry about it?” You are a teacher. It is literally your job to teach.
lines.zh: : 「别担心」是什么意思？您是老师。教书可就是您的工作啊。

lines.en: : If you aren’t willing to do even that much, I’ll talk to my mother and have myself transferred right now.
lines.zh: : 如果连这点事您都不肯做，我就去跟我母亲说，现在就转走。

lines.en: : Sure. See ya.
lines.zh: : 行啊。再见。

lines.en: : It was nice seeing you again.
lines.zh: : 很高兴又见了你一面。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday24
: You-
: Show some respect! Do you have any idea who I am?
lines.zh: : 放尊重些！你知道我是谁吗？

lines.en: : Some rich girl looking for special treatment.
lines.zh: : 某个想要特殊待遇的有钱大小姐。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday25
: How...dare you...
lines.zh: : 你……怎么敢……

lines.en: : Mother!
lines.zh: : 母亲！

lines.en: : Oh, Tsubasa! You’re already here.
lines.zh: : 哦，Tsubasa！你已经在这儿了。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday26
: Good afternoon, dear! Don’t mind me. I’m just here to observe my daughter’s first day in her new[school].
lines.zh: : 下午好，亲爱的！别管我。我只是来看看我女儿在新[school]的第一天。

lines.en: : Mo...Mother? Hello?
lines.zh: : 母……母亲？您好？

lines.en: : I am being abused. I require assistance.
lines.zh: : 我正在遭受虐待。我需要帮助。

lines.en: : Being treated like everyone else isn’t abuse, Tooru.
lines.zh: : 被和其他人一样对待算不上虐待，Tooru。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday27
: My name is Touka!
lines.zh: : 我叫 Touka！

lines.en: : Tomoko?
lines.zh: : Tomoko？

lines.en: scene toukafirstday28
: TOUKA!
lines.zh: : TOUKA！

lines.en: : TOUKA TSUKIOKA OF THE TSUKIOKA FAMILY! THE WEALTHIEST FAMILY IN KUMON-MI!
lines.zh: : TSUKIOKA 家族的 TOUKA TSUKIOKA！KUMON-MI 最富有的家族！

lines.en: : YOU WILL REFER TO ME BY MY PROPER NAME OR-
lines.zh: : 你要用我正确的名字称呼我，否则——

lines.en: : Why don’t you go take a seat, Toshiko?
lines.zh: : 你不如先去坐下吧，Toshiko？

lines.en: : MOTHER! CALL FATHER IMMEDIATELY! I WANT THIS MAN ARRESTED!
lines.zh: : 母亲！马上给父亲打电话！我要把这个男人抓起来！

lines.en: : No can do, dear! I’ve already entrusted your future to him.
lines.zh: : 这可不行，亲爱的！我已经把你的未来托付给他了。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday29
: I am to wed this heathen?!
lines.zh: : 我要嫁给这个异教徒？！

lines.en: : Not if I have a say in it...
lines.zh: : 只要我还能说得上话，就不行……

lines.en: scene toukafirstday30
: Wait...you’re the other person from the dojo!
lines.zh: : 等等……你是道场里的另一个人！

lines.en: : Ayane Amamiya! I remember that name.
lines.zh: : Ayane Amamiya！我记得这个名字。

lines.en: : Nice to see you again, Touka. Are you transferring into our class?
lines.zh: : 又见面了，Touka。你要转到我们班来吗？

lines.en: scene toukafirstday31
: That was the plan. But it appears that our teacher has decided to do anything but the job he is being paid for.
lines.zh: : 本来是这样。不过看来我们的老师决定做任何事，就是不干他拿钱该干的那件事。

lines.en: : Not to mention I’m not seeing my special desk anywhere in sight.
lines.zh: : 更别提我到处都没看到我的专属桌子。

lines.en: : Special desk?
lines.zh: : 专属桌子？

lines.en: : Of course. I’ve been using the same desk since elementary[school] and I refuse to study without-
lines.zh: : 当然。我从小学起就一直用同一张桌子，没有它我拒绝学习——

lines.en: : Oh, Touka darling...That desk wouldn’t fit in the classroom. So you’ll be using a standard one starting today.
lines.zh: : 哦，Touka 亲爱的……那张桌子放不进教室。所以从今天起你要用普通的那种。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday32
: St...Standard?
lines.zh: : 普……普通？

lines.en: : You...do actually remember her name, right?
lines.zh: : 你……其实记得她的名字吧？

lines.en: : Of course. But I’m not going to let some girl start dictating the way I run my class just because she comes from money.
lines.zh: : 当然记得。但我不会因为有某个姑娘出身有钱，就让她来对我的班级指手画脚。

lines.en: : I’d do the same thing if you started making me give you special lessons.
lines.zh: : 要是你开始逼我给你开小灶，我也会这么对你的。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday33
: Oh, you’ve given me plenty of “special lessons,” Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哦，您可给我上过不少「小灶」呢，Sensei。

lines.en: : How is it at all fair that she receives special lessons and I do not?
lines.zh: : 她有小灶而我没有，这算哪门子公平？

lines.en: : She is...not talking about the same type of lessons you are, Tama.
lines.zh: : 她……说的和你说的不是同一种课，Tama。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday34
: I will not allow my mind to be tampered with by a man like you.
lines.zh: : 我不会让自己的心智被你这种男人污染。

lines.en: : Good. That’s probably the smartest thing you could do right now.
lines.zh: : 很好。这大概是你现在能做的最聪明的事。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday35
: The first step to truly experiencing the outside world is to not imagine that everything revolves around you.
lines.zh: : 真正体验外部世界的第一步，就是别以为一切都围着你转。

lines.en: : You won’t get special treatment while you’re here, because you’re no more special than anyone else.
lines.zh: : 你在这儿不会得到特殊待遇，因为你并不比任何人更特殊。

lines.en: : If you can’t accept that, you should probably just go back home to your butlers and your maids or whatever and study at your “special desk.”
lines.zh: : 如果你接受不了，那你大概就该回家去找你的管家和女仆什么的，在你的「专属桌子」前学习。

lines.en: : But, if you want to see what “commoners” live like, feel free to stick around.
lines.zh: : 不过，如果你想看看「平民」是怎么过日子的，欢迎留下来。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday36
: Mother! Call father immediately!
lines.zh: : 母亲！马上给父亲打电话！

lines.en: Damn. I thought for a second that might actually work.
lines.zh: 该死。有那么一瞬间我还以为真能奏效呢。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday37
: What’s wrong, my love?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，我的宝贝？

lines.en: : This[school] is bad. I want to return to the manor.
lines.zh: : 这所[school]很糟糕。我想回庄园去。

lines.en: : The day just started, dear. You can’t go home yet.
lines.zh: : 今天才刚开始呢，亲爱的。你还不能回家。

lines.en: : What do you mean I can’t go home? How am I supposed to learn without my desk and without a teacher?
lines.zh: : 什么叫我还不能回家？没有我的桌子、又没有老师，我怎么学习啊？

lines.en: : We have a teacher. He’s just a little weird.
lines.zh: : 我们有老师啊。他只是有点怪而已。

lines.en: : Hey.
: “A little weird” seems to be quite the understatement.
lines.zh: : 「有点怪」似乎是个相当保守的说法。

lines.en: : You’ll get used to it.
lines.zh: : 你会习惯的。

lines.en: : I’m Chika, by the way. I’m kind of friends with your mom, I guess. So I hope you and I can get along as well.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，我叫 Chika。我大概算是你妈妈的朋友吧。所以希望我们也能相处得好。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday38
: Get along? With me?
lines.zh: : 相处得好？跟我？

lines.en: : Yeah! You’re new here, and that can be pretty overwhelming at first.
lines.zh: : 对啊！你是新来的，一开始肯定会有点招架不住。

lines.en: : Especially when I’m sure everything is like, totally different from your last[school].
lines.zh: : 尤其是我敢肯定，这里的一切跟你上一个[school]完全不一样。

lines.en: : But, weirdly enough, you’re in pretty good hands. This place really isn’t all that bad.
lines.zh: : 不过说来也怪，你算是落到好人手里了。这地方真的没那么糟。

lines.en: : So if you ever need somebody to talk to or anything like that, just come look for me in the back of the classroom.
lines.zh: : 所以如果你需要找人聊聊什么的，直接到教室后排找我就行。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday39
: Oh! Um...
: Thank you very much, Chika. I’m very excited to get to know you.
lines.zh: : 非常感谢你，Chika。我很期待能认识你。

lines.en: : And then everyone lived happily ever-
lines.zh: : 于是大家幸福快乐地——

lines.en: scene toukafirstday40
: Silence. I may not understand how to act in places like this, but even I can understand when I am being ridiculed.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。我也许不懂在这种地方该怎么表现，但就算我也看得出来自己正在被嘲笑。

lines.en: : At the very least, please address me by my actual name. It may be a silly thing to press you on, but it is very important to me.
lines.zh: : 至少，请用我真名来称呼我。为这种事较真也许很傻，但它对我非常重要。

lines.en: : Fine.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: : Welcome to the class, Touka.
lines.zh: : 欢迎来到这个班，Touka。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday41
: Thank you very much...
lines.zh: : 非常感谢您……

lines.en: : Oh my. This is the cutest expression I’ve seen on your face in years.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。这是你这几年来脸上出现过最可爱的表情了。

lines.en: : I knew this[school] was the right choice for you.
lines.zh: : 我就知道这所[school]是最适合你的选择。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday42
: Wha-
: The climate control in this room is just...virtually non-existent!
lines.zh: : 这间屋子的温度调节简直……形同虚设！

lines.en: : If my face is as red as it feels, that is the reason why! This is no cute expression!
lines.zh: : 如果我的脸真有感觉上那么红，那就是因为这个！这绝不是什么可爱的表情！

lines.en: : And...And it has nothing to do with embarrassment! I swear!
lines.zh: : 而且……而且这跟害羞一点关系都没有！我发誓！

lines.en: : Right, dear. Of course it doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 是是是，亲爱的。当然没关系。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday43
: Well, it's premature, but I suppose I’ve seen all I’ve needed to see here.
lines.zh: : 嗯，虽然早了点，不过我想该看的我都看到了。

lines.en: What? It's been like two minutes.
lines.zh: 什么？才过了两分钟吧。

lines.en: : I understand that there will be no special treatment for her, but please at least see to it that my daughter makes it to her limo after the[school] day ends.
lines.zh: : 我明白她不会得到特殊待遇，不过至少请您确保我女儿在[school]一天结束后能顺利上她的豪车。

lines.en: : You’re sending a limo for her?
lines.zh: : 你们派豪车来接她？

lines.en: : She has fencing lessons shortly after the final bell in a remote location that only our driver is familiar with.
lines.zh: : 放学铃响后不久她要去一个偏僻的地方上击剑课，只有我们的司机认得路。

lines.en: : That much shouldn’t be a problem, should it?
lines.zh: : 这点小事应该不成问题吧？

lines.en: : I...guess not?
lines.zh: : 我……应该没问题吧？

lines.en: : Splendid.
lines.zh: : 好极了。

lines.en: : And thank you again for taking her in at such an inconvenient time of the year. We really do appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 再次感谢您在一年中这么不方便的时候收下她。我们真的很感激。

lines.en: : Touka, please thank your teacher.
lines.zh: : Touka，谢谢你的老师。
: ……谢谢您。

lines.en: : Louder, dear.
lines.zh: : 大声点，亲爱的。

lines.en: scene toukafirstday44
: TH-TH-THANKYOUFORLOOKINGAFTERME!
lines.zh: : 谢——谢——谢——谢您照顾我！

lines.en: : I WILL NOW GO SIT AT MY STANDARD, NOT SPECIAL DESK AND NOT LEARN ABOUT ENGLISH!
lines.zh: : 我现在要去坐我那张普通的、一点都不特殊的桌子，并且不学英语！

lines.en: : GOODBYE!
lines.zh: : 再见！

lines.en: scene black
Touka doesn’t choose a desk right away, but instead bashfully walks over to Ayane and tugs on her sleeve.
lines.zh: Touka 没有立刻挑桌子，而是扭扭捏捏地走到 Ayane 身边，拽了拽她的袖子。

lines.en: It seems that Ayane understands exactly what Touka needs (Probably due to rich girl senses or something) and then proceeds to find her a free desk.
lines.zh: 看来 Ayane 完全明白 Touka 需要什么（大概是因为有钱人直觉什么的），于是帮她找了一张空桌子。

lines.en: The two of them sit down together and begin to talk as I see Tsubasa out.
lines.zh: 我送 Tsubasa 出去的时候，她们两个坐到一起开始聊天。

lines.en: Chika winds up leaving at the same time after receiving a call from her sister, so she isn’t able to help Touka get any more accustomed to life here than she’s already become over the last twenty minutes or so.
lines.zh: Chika 接到她姐姐的电话后也同时离开了，所以她没能帮 Touka 适应到比这二十来分钟里已经适应的程度更多。

lines.en: Either way, the rest of the day proceeds pretty normally and then, just as all things do, it comes to an end.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，这一天剩下的时间过得还算正常，然后就像所有事物一样，结束了。

lines.en: I’m not sure if Touka likes it here yet, but I guess I’ve been lucky enough so far to have almost every new student be welcomed with open arms immediately.
lines.zh: 我还不确定 Touka 喜不喜欢这里，不过我想我到目前为止还算幸运，几乎每个新学生一进来就受到了张开双臂的欢迎。

lines.en: At the very least, even if she doesn’t wind up liking me (Which I’m sure she will because I’m me), she’ll have Ayane and Chika.
lines.zh: 至少，就算她最后不喜欢我（我相信她会喜欢的，因为我就是我），她还有 Ayane 和 Chika。

lines.en: And anyone else willing to look past her outward appearance and social status.
lines.zh: 以及任何愿意不去在意她外表和社会地位的人。

lines.en: Which, judging by the mood of the room-
lines.zh: 而从教室里的气氛来看——

lines.en: Does not seem like many people.
lines.zh: 那样的人似乎不多。

$ day297 = True
Touka’s affection has increased to [touka_love]!
lines.zh: Touka 的好感度提升到了 [touka_love]！
